verdict.rationale: Treasury is exposed through the Stripe API (FinancialAccount objects, OutboundPayments, money movement) and emits programmatic events, which allows headless, scripted operation. A probe shows Stripe documents an official CLI, but nothing in the pack covers CI usage, non-interactive auth, or test-mode automation specifically for Treasury. missing for 10: Treasury-specific CLI/CI documentation, non-interactive credential and automation guidance, hands-on corroboration of headless/CI runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Stripe Treasury for Platforms provides users with a container for money called a FinancialAccount that is separate from their Payments balance.
Send funds from a Stripe payments balance | Instant | Stripe API
